name: whatsapp-gemini-bot
description: WhatsApp automation bot using whatsapp-web.js and Gemini

scripts.tunnel-url: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const m=execSync('docker logs kaira-tunnel 2>&1').toString().match(/https:\/\/[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com/g);console.log(m?m[m.length-1]:'no URL in logs - is kaira-tunnel running?')"
